physical_harm: Injuries causing instantaneous death, including lacerations on the head, mastoid region, and chin
premeditation_planning: Not found; the act was a sudden loss of self-control due to persistent provocation
motive: To prevent the deceased from misbehaving with his daughter after consuming alcohol
key_evidence_accepted: The Supreme Court accepted the statement of the appellant's daughter (P.W.6) that the appellant confessed to murdering his son-in-law, as well as the post-mortem report indicating fatal injuries caused by a bamboo stick.
witness_credibility: The court assessed the main witnesses as credible, particularly the daughter of the accused, whose statement was considered clear, specific, unambiguous, and trustworthy, despite not providing the exact words of the accused's confession.

legal_representation.state: Nalin Kohli, Sr. AAG, Aastik Dhingra, Anshul Malik, Shuvodeep Roy, Advs.

investigation_status: FIR registered, charge sheet filed, trial completed

appeal_history.trial_court: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
appeal_history.supreme_court: Appeal allowed in part, sentence modified to ten years rigorous imprisonment

prosecution_argument: The prosecution argued that the appellant was guilty of committing the murder of his son-in-law, based on the evidence including the confession made by the appellant to his daughter and the post-mortem report indicating fatal injuries.
defence_argument: The defence argued that there was no eye witness to the occurrence and that the alleged confession made by the appellant could not be relied upon due to lack of direct evidence.
legal_principle_applied: The Supreme Court applied the legal principle under Exception I of Section 300 IPC, which provides that culpable homicide is not murder if the offender, while deprived of the power of self-control by grave and sudden provocation, causes the death of the person who gave the provocation or by mistake or accident.
precedent_relied_upon: Ajay Singh v. State of Maharashtra (2007) 12 Sec 341
sentencing_rationale: The final sentence was imposed to convert the life imprisonment awarded to the appellant to rigorous imprisonment of ten years, as the ends of justice would be adequately met by this modification.
judicial_mitigating_factors: The court weighed the appellant's motive to prevent his daughter from being harassed by the deceased, the sustained provocation from the deceased's behavior, and the lack of pre-meditation in the act.
